slots.notes: Fullscreen cover-cropped background photos forming the morning/night toggle pair. The active photo renders on bg-front; the same photo is duplicated onto bg-back as a blurred scale(1.2) backing layer during the swap. background-size:cover, background-position:center 40%, transform:scale(1.1). Order: [0]=light/morning, [1]=dark/night (default mount uses the dark/night image). A radial+linear darkening ::after overlay sits on top, so mid-tone photos with a centered subject read best.

Single UI typeface applied globally via the universal reset (font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif). Drives the 56px display headline, nav links, toggle labels, and the 300-weight body sentence. Weights used: 300/400/500/600/700. Native family 'Outfit', loaded from Google Fonts in index.html.

Single mark in the navbar lockup beside the brand name (spec uses lucide-react Zap, size 32, strokeWidth 2). Tinted by CSS, not by the asset: #ffffff in dark theme, #000000 in light-theme (color transitions 0.5s ease). Replace with the brand's energy/logo glyph; supply as a currentColor-driven icon so theme tinting still works.
Browser tab / site icon, declared as <link rel=icon type=image/svg+xml href=/vite.svg>. Currently the generic Vite default placeholder; fill with the brand favicon.

mechanic: Fullscreen dual-layer theme toggle: clicking Morning/Night pulls the front background down (translateY(20vh) scale, cubic-bezier(0.32,0,0.67,0)) over a blurred backing copy, swaps the photo source at 300ms, then snaps back with overshoot easing while a frosted-glass pill slides between the two labels.
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 5 single component (useState/useEffect/useRef, no router or state lib); near-entirely vanilla CSS in index.css with Tailwind 3 installed but only minimally used; lucide-react for the one icon; Google Fonts 'Outfit' loaded via index.html.
reskinNotes: Copy is hardcoded in JSX (headline split across plain text + span.title-accent + trailing text, brand name 'reposit', 6 nav labels, CTA label, the Morning/Night toggle labels and '$0 for Electricity' subtext, body sentence) and must be edited in markup. The morning/night day-cycle narrative is baked into the toggle semantics, so a non-solar reskin needs a different toggle concept. Core neutrals #ffffff/#000000 are hardcoded inline on .logo/.brand-name/.cta-button (and their light-theme variants are separate selectors) rather than referencing the :root vars, so reskinning means editing rules beyond the custom-property block. There is no border colorRole: toggles and buttons use border:none. Background photos are referenced as local /public/images/*.webp but originate from Cloudinary source URLs that must be downloaded at build time, not fetched at runtime. Layout (56px headline, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -1px) is tuned to Outfit's metrics. The .pull-down transform and .toggle-btn.active color use !important, so any override CSS must match or exceed that specificity.
